scheme_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC and EBC Students (PMS-OBC)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
target_group: OBC, EBC and DNT students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary stages of education

eligibility_rules.description: Belongs to Other Backward Classes (OBC/BC) or Economically Backward Classes (EBC)
Passed matriculation or higher secondary examination
Parents' or guardian's total annual income does not exceed Rs 2,50,000 per annum
Enrolled in recognised post-matric degree course at accredited college/university
Not holding any other central or state scholarship concurrently

benefits.component: Academic allowance and compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement
benefits.amount: Up to Rs 20,000 per annum depending on course group
benefits.instalments: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account

required_documents: OBC / BC Community Certificate from Tahsildar / MeeSeva
Income Certificate showing annual family income up to Rs 2.50 lakh
Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account (NPCI seeded)
Current Year College Bonafide Certificate & Fee Structure
application_steps: Register online at National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or state portal (ePASS)
Complete Aadhaar Face / Biometric e-KYC authentication
Fill student profile, enter bank account with active DBT seeding, and select PMS-OBC
Upload attested certificates and submit for Institute verification
source_document: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post Matric Scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT, MoSJE
